cards.art: rabbit and bear duo at interrogation table
cards.lore: IDEA: If you write the rules of the game, you literally cannot lose.
cards.name: Uncle FrizzleBob & Lou
cards.power: PLAY: Ask the player to your left if they are ready to investigate themselves.

cards.art: wall covered in self-signed certificates
cards.lore: IDEA: A certificate of innocence is best signed by the accused.
cards.name: The Ten Certificates
cards.power: PLAY: Slam your hand on the table and declare NOTHING WRONG!

cards.art: giant ornate pen signing invisible document
cards.lore: IDEA: The conclusion is baked into the cake before the oven is turned on.
cards.name: The Golden Pen
cards.power: PLAY: Hand an invisible pen to a friend. Make them sign a blank contract.

cards.art: wax seal dripping with absurdist insignia
cards.lore: IDEA: Authority is just an expensive piece of wax.
cards.name: The Official Seal of Humbug
cards.power: PLAY: Stamp someone's forehead with your thumb. Yell HUMBUG!

cards.art: tortoise in judge's wig gesturing at tiny circle
cards.lore: IDEA: Define the scope of inquiry so precisely that inconvenient causes fall outside it.
cards.name: The Terms-of-Reference-Tortoise
cards.power: PLAY: Redefine the current argument so you are automatically right.

cards.art: dingo drawing circle in air, excluded evidence pile outside
cards.lore: IDEA: The conclusion is not reached, it is assumed from line one. The frame is the verdict.
cards.name: The Deliberate-Definition-Dingo
cards.power: PLAY: Draw a circle in the air. Everything outside the circle is fake news.

cards.art: rhinoceros in judicial robes pointing at snack pile
cards.lore: IDEA: Issues the blame assignment before the investigation concludes.
cards.name: The Roberts-Commission-Rhinoceros
cards.power: PLAY: Point at the person with the most snacks and declare them guilty.

cards.art: crocodile in suit banging gavel on thick report
cards.lore: IDEA: The commission is the product. The report is just the packaging.
cards.name: The Kangaroo-Commission-Crocodile
cards.power: PLAY: Close your eyes, bang the table, and announce the heat is off.

cards.art: camel in judge robes raising own hand as winner
cards.lore: IDEA: Seat a participant on the investigation of their own crimes.
cards.name: The Conflict-of-Interest-Camel
cards.power: PLAY: Offer to judge a contest you are currently competing in.

cards.art: vulture in committee chair accepting envelope with neutral expression
cards.lore: IDEA: Align the investigative body perfectly with the conclusion required.
cards.name: The Vested-Interest-Vulture
cards.power: PLAY: Look deeply impartial while accepting a hypothetical bribe.

cards.art: zebra at typewriter, finished report dated before inquiry
cards.lore: IDEA: Write the final report before the investigation holds its first hearing.
cards.name: The Zelikow-Zebra
cards.power: PLAY: Tell everyone how the movie ends before buying the tickets.

cards.art: pelican whispering into own ear, footnote pointing back to itself
cards.lore: IDEA: Rigor of form masks rigidity of a predetermined conclusion.
cards.name: The Preemptive-Outline-Pelican
cards.power: PLAY: Whisper a secret, then cite yourself as an anonymous expert.

cards.art: tapir chewing shredded tape with serene expression
cards.lore: IDEA: Destroy evidence under court order and confidently wait for nothing to happen.
cards.name: The Tape-Destroying-Tapir
cards.power: PLAY: Pretend to eat a playing card. Chew loudly.

cards.art: badger stepping through black curtain, name stamp REDACTED
cards.lore: IDEA: No documentation is required where no documentation is permitted.
cards.name: The Black-Site-Badger
cards.power: PLAY: Step behind a curtain or chair. Claim you no longer legally exist.

cards.art: clam sealed tight surrounded by growing pile of reports
cards.lore: IDEA: Volume of investigation substitutes for quality of investigation.
cards.name: The Climategate-Clam
cards.power: PLAY: Repeat Nothing to see here until everyone gets bored and leaves.

cards.art: raccoon pocketing classified folder, shrugging
cards.lore: IDEA: The sanctioned version in the archive is the only version that happened.
cards.name: The Records-Raccoon
cards.power: PLAY: Put a card in your pocket. Declare it never existed.

cards.art: gorilla gavel suspended mid-slam above witness
cards.lore: IDEA: Cut off live testimony the exact second it approaches reality.
cards.name: The Gavel-Down-Gorilla
cards.power: PLAY: Slam your hand down exactly when someone says the word but.

cards.art: ibis in suit standing uncomfortably close to seated witness
cards.lore: IDEA: The authority of the instruction outweighs the authority of the evidence.
cards.name: The Intimidation-Ibis
cards.power: PLAY: Stand very close to a player and ask them if they are sure about that.

cards.art: mole with quill crossing name from long list
cards.lore: IDEA: Remove the testimony before it can even be scheduled.
cards.name: The Missing-Witness-Mole
cards.power: PLAY: Cross a friend's name off a piece of paper with dramatic flair.

cards.art: salamander leaning over witness, helpfully wrong speech bubble
cards.lore: IDEA: Remind a witness what they remember, before they remember it incorrectly.
cards.name: The Senility-Prompt-Salamander
cards.power: PLAY: Helpfully finish someone else's sentence completely wrong.

cards.art: rooster behind reception desk pointing at wall calendar years away
cards.lore: IDEA: Convert active political pressure into a pending administrative scheduling problem.
cards.name: The Review-Process-Rooster
cards.power: PLAY: Tell someone you'll answer their question in three to four years.

cards.art: heron at podium, nodding solemnly, INDEPENDENT COMMISSION banner behind
cards.lore: IDEA: Provide the optics of responsiveness without the substance of accountability.
cards.name: The Heat-Relief-Heron
cards.power: PLAY: Nod deeply. Look reassuring. Do absolutely nothing.

cards.art: iguana in hearing room with INDEPENDENT sticky note on forehead
cards.lore: IDEA: The record shows consensus because independence without the requirement of it. [NOTE: IDEA text appears garbled in this print version — recommend review]
cards.name: The Independent-Commission-Iguana
cards.power: PLAY: Write INDEPENDENT on a sticky note and stick it to your forehead.

cards.art: flamingo balancing enormous report on head, eyes closed
cards.lore: IDEA: The form confirms the authority of the report regardless of the content.
cards.name: The Final-Report-Flamingo
cards.power: PLAY: Hold a heavy book over your head and refuse to read it.

cards.art: ferret in mortarboard pointing at chart with absurdly precise decimal
cards.lore: IDEA: The precision of the number substitutes for the validity of the method.
cards.name: The Ferguson-Ferret
cards.power: PLAY: Invent a highly specific statistic (e.g., 84.3%) to win a petty argument.

cards.art: hyena screaming headline, tiny whisper bubble with correction
cards.lore: IDEA: Rely on the certainty that almost no one will trace the footnote.
cards.name: The Headline-Hypothesis-Hyena
cards.power: PLAY: Shout a wild headline. Whisper the retraction.

cards.art: python coiled around stack of rejected papers, lone paper raised triumphant
cards.lore: IDEA: The record shows consensus because dissent was actively purged.
cards.name: The Peer-Review-Python
cards.power: PLAY: Hide your opponent's cards and declare yourself the default winner.

cards.art: salamander high-fiving own reflection, NOTHING FOUND badge visible
cards.lore: IDEA: The finding of no wrongdoing is accepted when you investigate yourself.
cards.name: The Self-Exoneration-Salamander
cards.power: PLAY: High-five yourself and announce you are innocent of all charges.

cards.art: sparrow reporter recoiling from story card, access badge shaking
cards.lore: IDEA: The threat of losing access outweighs the value of the story.
cards.name: The Spiked-Story-Sparrow
cards.power: PLAY: Cover your hand with a card, look terrified, and pull back.

cards.art: lynx relabeling LIE jar as STRATEGIC NARRATIVE FRAMEWORK
cards.lore: IDEA: Rename events to neutralize their political charge before they enter search engines.
cards.name: The Label-Change-Lynx
cards.power: PLAY: Call a lie a sub-optimal narrative alignment.

cards.art: bear clutching classified binder to chest with wide smile
cards.lore: IDEA: The gesture of openness substitutes for the act of transparency.
cards.name: The Binder-Bear
cards.power: PLAY: Hug a closed binder tightly and refuse to let anyone see it.

cards.art: dingo gesturing dramatically at window while pocketing files
cards.lore: IDEA: Escalate a crisis elsewhere the exact moment domestic pressure peaks.
cards.name: The Distraction-Deployment-Dingo
cards.power: PLAY: Point out the window and yell Look at that! then steal a card.

cards.art: swan smiling beatifically while swapping cards under table
cards.lore: IDEA: Seal the investigation's findings as the price of the plea.
cards.name: The Sweetheart-Deal-Swan
cards.power: PLAY: Trade your worst card for a friend's best card, smiling innocently.

cards.art: panther in suit raising arms after game ends, PARDONED stamp visible
cards.lore: IDEA: The legal accountability window closes seamlessly with the administration.
cards.name: The Pardon-Architecture-Panther
cards.power: PLAY: Wait until a game is over, then declare you actually won.

cards.art: crane in timeout chair with room service tray, five-star décor
cards.lore: IDEA: A minimum-security arrangement signals that exposure has a ceiling.
cards.name: The Camp-Cupcake-Crane
cards.power: PLAY: Act like you are staying at a 5-star resort while in timeout.

cards.art: armadillo in trenchcoat, finger to lips, CLASSIFIED stamp background
cards.lore: IDEA: Prosecution becomes inconvenient when the asset acquires a classified dimension.
cards.name: The Intelligence-Asset-Armadillo
cards.power: PLAY: Refuse to explain yourself. Say you belong to intelligence.

cards.art: crocodile extending handshake, million-dollar promise visible, vault locked
cards.lore: IDEA: The announcement does the work without the disclosure.
cards.name: The Client-List-Crocodile
cards.power: PLAY: Promise a friend you will give them a million dollars tomorrow. (Don't.)

cards.art: narwhal gesturing emphatically at empty space where cup clearly sits
cards.lore: IDEA: The denial transfers the burden of proof directly to the skeptic.
cards.name: The No-Client-List-Narwhal
cards.power: PLAY: Deny the existence of the cup of water currently sitting in front of you.

cards.art: manatee floating motionless while urgent papers swirl around
cards.lore: IDEA: Inertia is sufficient force to maintain the cover-up.
cards.name: The Institutional-Momentum-Manatee
cards.power: PLAY: Go completely limp. Let the game continue around you.

cards.art: secretary bird staring unblinking, ABSOLUTE CERTAINTY badge prominent
cards.lore: IDEA: Eyewitness certainty as a substitute for contested forensic evidence.
cards.name: The Suicide-Certainty-Secretary-Bird
cards.power: PLAY: Stare unblinking at a player and declare an opinion as absolute scientific law.

cards.art: tiger reading final page of report first, inquiry still being assembled
cards.lore: IDEA: The conclusion precedes the inquiry across every single case without exception.
cards.name: The Terms-Bake-the-Conclusion-Tiger
cards.power: PLAY: Read the last page of a book out loud before anyone starts reading.

cards.art: platypus connecting random objects with red string, triumphant expression
cards.lore: IDEA: The methodology is completely consistent; only the application varies.
cards.name: The Pattern-Recognition-Platypus
cards.power: PLAY: Point at three random objects and convincingly explain how they are related.

cards.art: raven with microphone narrating oblivious player
cards.lore: IDEA: Historical analysis is not required; present observation is sufficient.
cards.name: The Real-Time-Cover-Up-Raven
cards.power: PLAY: Start narrating the actions of the player across from you like a sports caster.

cards.art: black cat pointing directly at enormous elephant in corner, room stunned
cards.lore: IDEA: Naming the operation is the exact act the cover-up requires to prevent.
cards.name: The Kayfabe-Cover-Up-Conclusion-Cat
cards.power: PLAY: Name the elephant in the room. Say it out loud.

cards.art: ram in wig speaking into microphone at incomprehensible speed
cards.lore: IDEA: Speed and authority in absolute service of misdirection.
cards.name: The Roberts-Commission-Ram
cards.power: PLAY: Speak incredibly fast and declare the debate over.

cards.art: donkey in CIA suit investigating cookie theft, cookie prominently in paw
cards.lore: IDEA: Professional biography as a massive, screaming conflict of interest.
cards.name: Allen-Dulles-Donkey
cards.power: PLAY: Investigate who stole the cookies while holding a cookie.

cards.art: narwhal in uniform smiling at camera, book mockup visible, conviction stamp behind
cards.lore: IDEA: Total lack of accountability functioning as a lucrative career opportunity.
cards.name: Oliver-North-Narwhal
cards.power: PLAY: Break a rule, smile for the camera, and ask for a book deal.

cards.art: zebrafish typing pre-written apology, calendar shows future date
cards.lore: IDEA: Pre-write the structural container that all subsequent truth must fit inside.
cards.name: Zelikow-Zebrafish
cards.power: PLAY: Draft an apology text for something you plan to do tomorrow.

cards.art: squid shaking own tentacle, certificate CLEARED floating above
cards.lore: IDEA: The finding of innocence and the finder of innocence are exactly the same entity.
cards.name: The Self-Investigation-Squid
cards.power: PLAY: Shake your own hand and congratulate yourself on a job well done.

cards.art: condor in century-spanning collage of identical headlines
cards.lore: IDEA: The technique does not evolve because it simply does not need to.
cards.name: The Century-of-Cover-Ups-Condor
cards.power: PLAY: Tell a story that loops perfectly back to the beginning.

cards.art: elephant in trenchcoat in doorway, everyone speculating behind
cards.lore: IDEA: The legal system stops entirely at the intelligence community's boundary.
cards.name: The Epstein-Intelligence-Elephant
cards.power: PLAY: Walk into a room, refuse to elaborate, let everyone make up their own excuse.

cards.art: ancient crocodile motionless amid crumbling empires, OPERATIONAL SINCE 1947 plaque
cards.lore: IDEA: Persist not through active maintenance, but through the immense gravity of institutions.
cards.name: The Continuity-Mechanism-Crocodile
cards.power: PLAY: Sit perfectly still and win the game by outlasting everyone else.

cards.art: terrier furiously taking notes, corkboard of connections behind
cards.lore: IDEA: The cover-up's most vulnerable moment is before it solidifies into the official record.
cards.name: The Transcript-Terrier
cards.power: PLAY: Take notes during the game. Use them against people later.

cards.art: capybara serenely floating amid frantic opinion bubbles
cards.lore: IDEA: Crowd-sourced pattern recognition acts as the ultimate investigative method.
cards.name: The Comment-Section-Capybara
cards.power: PLAY: Ask everyone for their opinion, then just chill.

cards.art: weasel pointing at repeating pattern on live feed
cards.lore: IDEA: Historical analysis confirms; present observation acts.
cards.name: The Real-Time-Watcher-Weasel
cards.power: PLAY: Call out a pattern the exact second it starts repeating.

cards.art: salamander with magnifying glass locked onto single document, everything else blurred
cards.lore: IDEA: Individual investigative persistence produces actual, terrifying results.
cards.name: The Sayer-G-Salamander
cards.power: PLAY: Pick one tiny detail and refuse to let it go until the game ends.

cards.art: figure at podium reading pre-printed statement, self-investigation logo visible
cards.lore: IDEA: It is not a secret operation. It is standard operating procedure.
cards.name: The Standard Procedure
cards.power: PLAY: Read aloud: We investigated ourselves and found nothing wrong.

cards.art: elaborate signature overlaid on nine previous identical signatures
cards.lore: IDEA: The name has been used nine times. It will be used again before the month is old.
cards.name: The Tenth Signature
cards.power: PLAY: Sign your name with an absurd flourish.

cards.art: figure with magnifying glass at page bottom, enormous footnote revealed
cards.lore: IDEA: None of it required a conspiracy theory. All of it required reading to the footnotes.
cards.name: The Footnote
cards.power: PLAY: Always read the fine print. Especially now.

cards.art: FrizzleBob with backpack waving goodbye, confetti, LOU DAY banner
cards.lore: IDEA: Anarchy requires warmth. Sabotage requires joy.
cards.name: Stay Fluffy (The Sign-Off)
cards.power: PLAY: Wish everyone a Happy Lou Day! and pack up the game.
